october['yt_per_angler'] = october['yt'] / october['anglers']

print("=== October (doy 287-305) Summary by Season/Class ===")
oct_by_season = october.groupby(['fish_date_season', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt_per_angler': 'mean',
    'yt': 'sum',
    'fish_date_doy': 'count'
}).round(3)
oct_by_season.columns = ['avg_yt_per_angler', 'total_yt', 'num_trips']
